essence: A fire pit furnished with three rims has a prescribed width as part of its ritual construction.
The prescribed structure has a twelve-finger breadth and length and is associated with a seven-flamed fire.
The measure of the threads beginning with the Śiva hand line is defined as two intervals.
These lines may undergo bending, contraction, or projection as alternative adjustments.
The rule for the weapons is enjoined by all scriptures.
